title: 10. Exercises: Debugging Concurrent Code
summary: Create tool that finds potential deadlocks in code statically.
objectives: Solve the Debugging Concurrent Code exercises without looking at the lesson
Test edge cases and explain your approach

sections.title: Exercises
sections.body:
### Exercise 1: Deadlock Finder

Create tool that finds potential deadlocks in code statically.

### Exercise 2: Race Condition Reproducer

Create tool to reproduce race conditions reliably.

### Exercise 3: Task Visualizer

Create visual timeline of async task execution.

### Exercise 4: Memory Leak Detector

Create detector for memory leaks in concurrent code.

### Exercise 5: Lock Contention Analyzer

Create analyzer for lock contention hotspots.

### Exercise 6: Event Loop Monitor

Create real-time monitor for event loop health.

### Exercise 7: Thread Dump Tool

Create tool for structured thread dumps.

### Exercise 8: Async Call Graph

Create async call graph generator.

### Exercise 9: Timeout Debugger

Create debugger for finding tasks that cause timeouts.

### Exercise 10: Concurrency Fuzzer

Create fuzzer to find concurrency bugs.
